items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: We did a car thing for Plymouth Automobile with Red Norvo actually, he was on the thing.

ctx.x: So I submitted a lot of things. We finally did Cheerios. We did Plymouth Automobiles, we did Borden’s Instant Coffee.
We did a car thing for Plymouth Automobile with Red Norvo actually, he was on the thing.

And a lot of these major accounts we got into, and we made a fortune doing it. Singing, of course I got the fee for arranging, I got the creative fee, I got the fee for leader, I got the fee for piano.

items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: one whole summer we had Jackie and Roy opposite.

ctx.x: And then in the Sands one year, one summer, one whole summer we had Jackie and Roy opposite.
